purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) system and handles monthly billing/claim aggregation processing (国保・請求書集計処理 – National Health Insurance claim document aggregation). It reads a temporary claim file, patient and insured-person information, system management master data, and produces updated claim records and printed output.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese National Health Insurance)

notable_features: Extensive use of COPY statements for modular record layouts (CPPTINF.INC, CPHKNJAINF.INC, CPSYSKANRI.INC, etc.)
Japanese-language comments encoded in Latin-1 (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS garbled)
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for shell invocation
OCCURS tables for city-number conversion and 2007 public expense codes
Multiple indexed and sequential file selects
61 CALL statements indicating heavy use of external subprograms (DB access, print, date conversion, etc.)
Revision history embedded in comments (versions 01.00.01 through 01.00.07)
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but contains Japanese text (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS), causing mojibake in comments. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 107174 bytes; full procedure division not visible, but structural indicators (4 divisions, 87 PIC clauses, 96 PERFORMs, 61 CALLs) confirm a substantial production batch program. No COMP-3 usage detected despite being a financial/billing application, which is slightly unusual but not disqualifying.
